## How was it checked?

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in the code or screenshots
- [ ] Any new script or API host is added to the CSP in `vercel.json` and `public/_headers`
- [ ] Copy stays ad-safe: no "genuine", "official", "instant", "cheapest", "hack" or unverified discounts; reseller disclaimer, region and delivery details kept
- [ ] Prices or products changed in Wix are mirrored in `src/catalog.ts`
